_comment: Subset of the bank-automation v2.0 private-config used by the statements workflow. Copy to private-config.json and fill in real values. NEVER commit private-config.json.
_match_help: match rules route statement emails to an account. All case-insensitive: from/to = substring of sender/recipient, subject/filename = regex. Empty rules are ignored; all non-empty rules must match; an account with no rules never matches. Optional per-account 'key' sets the id used by the sidecar; default is <bank>.<slug(name)>.
